recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If an equivalent tab-label problem exists in the modern Structured Data Capture IG, handle that in the external SDC IG repository/package rather than editing the FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-6840 asked to fix the StructuredDataCaptureAnswers StructureDefinition page because labels on different tabs or sections reused the same titles; Jira records the final resolution as Published/Persuasive with resolution text "fix".
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-6840. The closest historical application is commit 5c3da7ea0826e12bd97770dc6c9c2081550bd354, which updated headings on the SDC profiles including questionnaireanswers-sdc-profile-introduction.xml. Later commit c51b8682420300c0f51dd0ad260d0be7f5ae20ab implemented FHIR-8480 by renaming QuestionnaireAnswers to QuestionnaireResponse while carrying the SDC answer-profile content forward.
additional_context: The SDC implementation guide content was moved out of the old source locations, then the old guides/sdc implementation-guide files were deleted from core in commit 9840423d9e1a74dd5011ec394e316afeb02c067d. Current source has no StructuredDataCaptureAnswers, questionnaireanswers-sdc-profile, or questionnaireresponse-sdc-profile file; source/igs.xml leaves the old SDC IG entries commented out, and current Questionnaire notes link readers to the external Structured Data Capture IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No current FHIR-core source change is appropriate because the affected profile/tab-label source is retired and outside the current build.

related_jiras.note: Renamed QuestionnaireAnswers to QuestionnaireResponse, superseding the old answer-profile artifact before the SDC IG was removed from core.
